name: casa-roble-pos
description: POS táctil para restaurantes: Next.js + Express + SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.docker:build: docker build --target api -t restpos-api:latest . && docker build --target web -t restpos-web:latest .
